About Your Little Surprise

We handcraft pipe cleaner (chenille) flower bouquets with love and creativity. Every tulip, lily, hydrangea and lavender sprig is shaped by hand, so your bouquet stays fresh forever. We also make chocolate bouquets, photo bouquets and combinations of flowers, chocolates and photos. Choose your colours and design for birthdays, anniversaries, celebrations, and all your special gifting moments.
